messages:
jamie: Heads up — ap-southeast1 saw a handful of GPU attach failures between 03:40-03:52 UTC. Observed nvme media errors on local drives and a couple transient ext4 remounts. noticed higher iops from background janitor jobs.
opsbot: ALERT: nvme_media_errors > 20 on gnode-apse1-17 (host) — recent deploy: scrub-scheduler v1.2.4.
li: I’m on metrics — correlating iops spike with cleaner/trim bursts. temp sensors show short 10-15s thermal spikes to 72C right before io timeouts. SMART also emitted a handful of warning sectors.
sasha: paste logs?
jamie: logs (snippet):
```
[03:41:12] nvme0: completion timeout, status=0x8
[03:41:12] nvme0: device error - media error count++
[03:41:13] EXT4-fs error (device nvme0n1): ext4_journal_check_start: Detected aborted journal
[03:41:13] kernel: blk_update_request: I/O error, dev nvme0n1, sector 12345678
```
thomas: that looks like short thermal-driven stalls. we’ve seen similar when janitor/concurrency aligned with big gpu batch jobs. possible mitigations: lower janitor concurrency, schedule scrubs to off-peak, or add short IO pacing for cleaner. Also there's a kernel NVME retry backport that reduces media-error escalation — can consider canary.
li: proposed immediate mitigations: 1) throttle janitor to concurrency=1 for ap-southeast1 pools, 2) add a 60s randomized jitter to scrub cron, 3) enable canary kernel nvme-retry on 5% hosts.
sasha: agree. how do we toggle janitor?
li: `kubectl -n infra patch deploy/janitor --patch '{"spec":{"template":{"spec":{"containers":[{"name":"janitor","env":[{"name":"CLEANER_CONCURRENCY","value":"1"}]}]}}}}'` — rolling update across ap-southeast1 tag. will roll as a canary to 10 nodes first.
jamie: can you also add a cron jitter via ConfigMap? put jitter=60s and reduce scrub frequency by 25% for region.
li: done, created cnf: scrub-config-apse1 v2 with jitter=60s, frequency=0.75x, canary label cnry-thermal-1. rolling to nodes with label region=ap-southeast1, canary set to 10 nodes.
opsbot: DEPLOYMENT: janitor patched (canary nodes=10) — started rolling at 03:58 UTC.
sasha: I’ll monitor iostat/smartctl and attach success rate. putting an alert to suppress noisy retries but track delta.
thomas: if canary shows >50% reduction in media errors we schedule full region rollout in 30m. otherwise we fallback and open a kernel backport ticket.
jamie: thanks team. watching dashboards. ping @li and @sasha if attach rate doesn't drop by 50% in 15m. :eyes: :thumbsup:
